events.title: Swiss stocks rise as Trump hints at possible deal to lower U.S. tariffs
events.body: Investing.com - Swiss stocks were higher in mid-morning European trading on Tuesday after U.S. President Donald Trump said he was working with officials in Switzerland to lower U.S. import tariffs placed on the Alpine country.
